title: A Lamp Still Lit
story: After closing, the librarian saw a lamp still lit in the stacks, though every reader had signed out. A damp coat hung on a chair, and a book about local tunnels lay open at a map. She called the caretaker instead of searching alone. Together they found a student who had fallen asleep behind the last shelf and missed the bell.

A reader who had already signed out
The person who drew the map

quiz.question: What do the lit lamp and the signed-out list suggest?
options: Someone may still be inside despite the list
Every reader took a lamp home
The stacks were being painted that night
The map showed an open exit
quiz.correctAnswer: Someone may still be inside despite the list
quiz.explanation: A lamp was still lit even though every reader had signed out, which suggests someone remained.
quiz.supportingSentence: After closing, the librarian saw a lamp still lit in the stacks, though every reader had signed out.

quiz.question: What was the student most likely doing before falling asleep?
options: Reading the open book about local tunnels

quiz.correctAnswer: Reading the open book about local tunnels
quiz.explanation: A book about tunnels lay open at a map, and the student was later found asleep nearby.
quiz.supportingSentence: A damp coat hung on a chair, and a book about local tunnels lay open at a map.

options: The shelves where books are kept

A bell that marks closing time
A person who looks after a building
quiz.correctAnswer: The shelves where books are kept
